critical_blockers.title: Manual Approval Gate for Low-Confidence Decisions
critical_blockers.description: Agent decisions with confidence < 0.70 require explicit human approval before execution. ConfidenceScorer in ooda_decider.py sets min_confidence_threshold=0.70, forcing decisions to pause waiting for human intervention.
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: Agent workflows halt on any moderately complex decision. System cannot execute autonomously when pattern confidence falls below 70%.
critical_blockers.evidence: ooda_decider.py line 82: requires_approval=True when confidence < 0.70; line 547 in self_healing.py: returns False with 'Action requires approval before execution'

critical_blockers.title: Incomplete State Persistence for Paused Executions
critical_blockers.description: Session state includes 'paused' status flag but checkpoint/resume mechanism is not fully implemented. If execution pauses, reconstruction context and in-flight operation recovery paths are incomplete.
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: When agents pause (due to low confidence, rate limits, or overrides), resuming from checkpoint cannot reconstruct full execution context. Sessions restart from scratch, losing accumulated work state.
critical_blockers.evidence: ContextFrame.status=['active','completed','failed','paused'] but no checkpoint_id or recovery_position fields

critical_blockers.title: Approval-Required Control Classes Cannot Auto-Execute
critical_blockers.description: Autonomy registry marks certain control classes (CC) as requiring explicit human approval. DecisionDirective cannot proceed if CC is in approval_required_classes list.
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: Any high-risk operation (credential updates, policy changes, deployment triggers) requires manual approval bottleneck. System cannot scale.
critical_blockers.evidence: registry.py line 237: return False with 'requires explicit human approval' if in approval_required_classes

critical_blockers.title: No Deterministic Failure Recovery Without Manual Intervention
critical_blockers.description: SelfHealingEngine detects issues and suggests remediation but apply_remediation() returns early on any requires_approval=True action. No automatic remediation cascade or escalation hierarchy.
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: Self-healing loop detects fixable issues but cannot remediate them without human approval. System stalls on fixable issues.
critical_blockers.evidence: self_healing.py line 547-548: if action.requires_approval and not dry_run: return False

critical_blockers.title: Incomplete Error Feedback Loop and Autonomous Learning
critical_blockers.description: Self-healing engine logs exceptions but does not feed failure patterns back into cognitive brain for autonomous learning. Action success/failure recorded but not used for future decision weighting.
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: System repeats the same failed remediations. No autonomous improvement over time. Every similar issue requires re-diagnosis.
critical_blockers.evidence: action.success set but no callback to pattern_discovery; outcome_analyzer.py exists but zero references from agents

critical_blockers.title: Rate-Limit Awareness Not Enforced at Decision Boundary
critical_blockers.description: GitHub API rate-limit state is tracked but not consulted before agent decisions. Agents can make decisions that will fail due to rate limits without pre-flight budget check.
affected_components: OODADecider.decide() does not check GitHub API budget
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: Agents exhaust GitHub API quota mid-execution. Workflows cascade-fail. Budget-aware degradation not implemented.
critical_blockers.evidence: rate_limit_orchestrator.py exists but ooda_decider.py never calls get_budget_status()

critical_blockers.title: Optional Dependency Import Failures Break Autonomy Chain
critical_blockers.description: Agents use repeated ad-hoc fallbacks for optional imports (numpy, hydra, transformers). Shared compatibility layer missing. Each module has independent try/except blocks.
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: Cloud agent sessions fail at import time before reaching autonomy logic. Each new optional dependency requires code changes.
critical_blockers.evidence: developer_orchestrator.py lines 28-72 show 5 separate try/except import blocks; Quick Win 1 identified as 'highest-priority gap' but central compatibility layer missing

critical_blockers.title: Undefined Agent Execution Boundaries and Completion Criteria
critical_blockers.description: Agents lack explicit handoff points. RemediationAction records executed=True/False but no clear Done-ness criterion. Agents don't know when to escalate vs iterate.
affected_components: cognitive_adapter.py:147-242 (ooda phases with no completion gate)
DecisionDirective has assigned_agents but no completion callback
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: Agents continue iterating or halt prematurely. No clear signal to orchestrator when task is complete. Multi-agent workflows cannot determine handoff readiness.
critical_blockers.evidence: RemediationAction.executed set but no completion_criteria or success_confidence_threshold

critical_blockers.title: Ambiguous and Conflicting Input Handling in Decision-Making
critical_blockers.description: DecisionDirective and Planner interfaces provide no mechanism for agents to handle ambiguous inputs or request clarification. Decisions are binary even when inputs conflict.
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: Agents make arbitrary decisions on ambiguous inputs. No way to request human clarification. Conflicting signals result in unpredictable behavior.
critical_blockers.evidence: DecisionDirective lacks ambiguity_score; no mechanism to request human input before deciding

critical_blockers.title: Incomplete Tie-Breaking Rules in Multi-Agent Orchestration
critical_blockers.description: QuantumAgentOrchestrator and AgentOrchestrator route failures to multiple agents but provide no tie-breaking when agents suggest conflicting actions.
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: Multiple agents return conflicting recommendations. No resolution strategy. System defaults to human decision-making.
critical_blockers.evidence: route_failure() returns list with no merger/fusion logic; entangle() creates coherence but measure_coherence() unused

critical_blockers.title: Missing Deterministic Restart Mechanism After Crashes
critical_blockers.description: Session state can be paused but no automatic retry logic or idempotency guarantees. If agent crashes mid-execution, no built-in mechanism to resume safely.
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: Agent crashes lose execution state. Restart requires full re-diagnosis. Repeated failures cause cascading resubmissions.
critical_blockers.evidence: ContextFrame has end_time but no last_successful_checkpoint_id; apply_remediation() not idempotent

critical_blockers.title: Agent Responsibilities Not Formally Defined or Enforced
critical_blockers.description: Agent roles mix concerns. Self-healing agent both detects and remediates. Orchestrators both route and execute. No clear OODA phase separation.
affected_components: Planner ABC allows any agent to do all 4 phases
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: Agents overreach and duplicate work. Harder to test and debug. Difficult to parallelize responsibility.
critical_blockers.evidence: SelfHealingEngine.diagnose() + apply_remediation() + act() all in one class; no role-specific interfaces

critical_blockers.title: No Autonomous Validation of Remediation Success
critical_blockers.description: After remediation is applied, agent does not autonomously verify issue is resolved. Success flag based on command exit code, not actual goal achievement.
affected_components: No feedback loop from act back to observe
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: Broken remedies marked as successful. System assumes exit code 0 = resolved. Partial fixes and false positives.
critical_blockers.evidence: apply_remediation line 597: action.success = True based only on command execution, no re-detection of original issue

critical_blockers.title: Cognitive Brain Learning Integration Incomplete
critical_blockers.description: Cognitive brain base classes defined but not fully integrated into agent decision-making. Pattern discovery and learning modules exist but agents don't feed outcomes back.
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: System does not improve over time. No memory of past patterns. No autonomous strategy optimization.
critical_blockers.evidence: outcome_analyzer.py and strategy_optimizer.py exist but zero references in agents/ or ooda_orchestrator.py

critical_blockers.title: No Cross-Agent Dependency Resolution or Coordination
critical_blockers.description: Agents can be entangled but entanglement does not enforce ordering. Agent A can proceed while Agent B it depends on is executing.
affected_components: No blocking/wait mechanism between entangled agents
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: Multi-agent workflows execute out-of-order. Race conditions in shared state. Dependent tasks start before prerequisites complete.
critical_blockers.evidence: entangle() marks agents 'waiting' but no join/wait/barrier; orchestrator never polls for completion before proceeding

critical_blockers.title: Incomplete Monitoring and Observability of Autonomous Decisions
critical_blockers.description: Decision auditing exists but no real-time alerting or monitoring of agent health. Cannot detect when autonomy is degrading without human review.
affected_components: No prometheus/grafana metrics for agent confidence or approval rate
DecisionDirective audit_id not published to monitoring pipeline
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: Operational blindness: humans don't know when agents are stalling until explicit escalation. No proactive alerting.
critical_blockers.evidence: AuditEvent logged but no metrics export; no Prometheus counters for requires_approval rate

critical_blockers.title: Incomplete Branching Strategy for Action Alternatives
critical_blockers.description: DecisionDirective.candidates list alternatives but only one is executed. No mechanism to try alternative actions if primary action fails.
affected_components: Planner.act() receives single Decision, not alternative list
No fallback/rollback to next-best candidate on failure
critical_blockers.impact_if_unfixed: If primary action fails, system halts instead of trying next-best alternative. Single point of failure per decision.
critical_blockers.evidence: DecisionDirective has ranked candidates list but act(decision) only receives one Decision; no fallback logic

high_priority_gaps: Shared optional-dependency compatibility layer not centralized (phase_3_autonomy.md Quick Win 1 incomplete)
Rate-limit budget checks not integrated into decision boundary
Approval-required classes block autonomy on high-value operations
Session pause/resume mechanism skeletal; no checkpoint restoration
incomplete_transitions: RemediationAction → applied action has no verification step before marking success
Decision → Execution assignment lacks completion handoff signal
Multi-agent recommendations → merged decision has no tie-breaking rule
Autonomy pause → resume has no guaranteed state reconstruction
missing_state_persistence: ContextFrame.status='paused' but no checkpoint_id or recovery_position fields
AgentMemory tracks access_count but no remediation_success_rate per action_type
Session serializer records status but not in-flight operation state
No idempotency markers on remediations to support safe retry
undefined_execution_boundaries: Planner.ooda_loop() is infinite loop potential; no built-in termination condition
Agent responsibilities mix observe+orient+decide+act; no role-specific interfaces
Orchestrator agents both route decisions AND execute; unclear handoff boundary
incomplete_feedback_loops: apply_remediation() sets action.success but no callback to update pattern success rates
Cognitive brain learning modules exist but ooda_loop never calls learn_from_outcome()
AuditEvent logged but not fed back to future orientation/decision context
No mechanism to detect and surface repeated failures autonomously
decision_making_gaps: Confidence threshold (0.70) is hard-coded; no per-decision-type thresholds
No ambiguity_flag or clarification_needed in Decision/DecisionDirective
Tie-breaking rules undefined when multiple agents suggest conflicting actions
DecisionDirective.alternatives list exists but act() ignores fallback strategy
recovery_gaps: No @idempotent decorators; remediations not safe to retry
apply_remediation subprocess.run can have partial side effects; no transaction boundaries
Crash recovery relies on ContextFrame.status='paused' but no automatic retry queue
No circuit breaker pattern for flaky operations
summary: System has core autonomy architecture (OODA loop, Planner interfaces, decision guardrails) but lacks critical mechanisms for full autonomy. Primary blockers: (1) manual approval gates on low-confidence decisions, (2) incomplete checkpoint/recovery after pauses, (3) fragmented optional dependency handling, (4) no automatic validation that remediations succeeded, (5) incomplete integration of cognitive brain learning. System cannot operate without human oversight for more than 3-5 sequential autonomous decisions.
